professionalSummary.text: Operates OpenSearch clusters on Kubernetes at a code-hosting company, handling node-pool upgrades and shard rebalancing during maintenance windows.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran four OpenSearch clusters on Kubernetes at Quillmark, a code-hosting company, handling node-pool upgrades and shard rebalancing during maintenance windows.

professionalSummary.text: Reduced p99 latency of the code-search query service from 2.4 seconds to 0.9 seconds by implementing per-repository routing, with metrics comparing two-week windows before and after the change in May 2023.
professionalSummary.witness: Reduced p99 latency of the code-search query service from 2.4 seconds to 0.9 seconds, comparing the two weeks before with the two weeks after the switch to per-repository routing in May 2023.

professionalSummary.text: Added back-pressure to indexing workers to prevent cluster overload during large repository imports, with retries capped at five attempts.
professionalSummary.witness: Added back-pressure to the indexing workers so that large repository imports paused queue consumption instead of overloading the clusters, with retries capped at five attempts.

professionalSummary.text: Drafted a 2024 storage forecast for search clusters based on twelve months of index-growth data, reviewed by the infrastructure lead before hardware ordering.
professionalSummary.witness: Drafted the 2024 storage forecast for the search clusters from twelve months of index-growth data; the infrastructure lead reviewed it before the hardware order.

experienceHighlights.text: Took part in weekday on-call rotation for the search stack and wrote two post-incident reviews.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took part in the weekday on-call rotation for the search stack and wrote two post-incident reviews.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Latency write-up for per-repository routing includes p50, p95, p99 tables for two-week windows in May-June 2023, routing design diagram, and query volume comparison within 5%.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the latency write-up for per-repository routing, with the query service's p50, p95 and p99 tables for 1 to 14 May 2023 (p99 2.4 s) and 22 May to 4 June 2023 (p99 0.9 s), the routing design diagram and a check showing query volume within 5% across the two windows.
